opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by destination, keyword and sort
opportunities.description: Search Trip.com's Attractions & Tickets section for activities in a chosen destination city with a keyword, then sort the results and open one.
steps: Open trip.com and click the 'Attractions & Tickets' tab (or the top-nav link).
Click the 'City or Region' field, type the destination city, and pick the matching suggestion from the dropdown.
Click the 'Discover New York Pass' / 'Keywords (Optional)' field and type the keyword.
On the results page, click the sort tab (e.g. 'Top Rated' or 'Lowest Price').
Click the result you want to inspect; optionally click 'Nearby' or the map/info icon on its detail page.

instances.values: Destination 'Hong Kong', keyword 'Park', sort 'Top Rated'; opened 'Shanghai Wild Animal Park' and clicked 'Nearby'.
Destination 'Seoul', keyword 'amusement park', sort 'Lowest Price'; interrupted by a Qatar Airways visit, resumed and opened 'Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park'.

opportunities.name: KOA campground search with filters, dates and destination
opportunities.description: Search KOA's campground finder for a destination, optional check-in/check-out dates and an amenity filter such as RV Site, then run 'Find a KOA'.
steps: On the KOA home page, click 'Filters' under the search bar to open advanced options.
Tick the stay-type checkbox needed (e.g. 'RV Site'), leaving others unchanged.
Click 'WHERE DO YOU WANT TO GO?' and type a destination; pick the matching suggestion from the dropdown.
Click 'CHECK IN', navigate to the target month with the 'Next' arrow if needed, and click the start day.
Click 'CHECK OUT', and click the end day (navigate forward as needed).

instances.values: Filters opened, 'RV Site' ticked, destination 'California', no dates set, 'FIND A KOA' clicked.
Destination 'Lansing' (suggestion 'Lansing, MI'), check-in 06/07/2023, check-out 06/12/2023, 'FIND A KOA' clicked.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways baggage allowance lookup by cabin class
opportunities.description: Open the Qatar Airways baggage allowance page and view the allowance table for a chosen cabin class.
steps: On the Qatar Airways home page, click the 'Experience' button in the top nav.
In the dropdown under 'Before you fly', click 'Baggage allowance'.
On the baggage guide page, click the tab for the required cabin class ('Economy Class', 'Business Class' or 'First Class').
Read the allowance table for that cabin.

instances.values: Cabin class 'Business Class' (same Experience > Baggage allowance path, repeated later in the session).
